about.title: How tokenusage works
about.subtitle: What we track, what we can't, and how the dollar math works.
about.trackedIntro: Each row below is a real source on your machine. Numbers come from local files — nothing leaves your computer in single-user mode.
about.untrackedIntro: These are limitations of the providers, not the dashboard.
about.costIntro: Token counts are multiplied by a per-token price table (data/prices.default.json). Edit prices at /prices to override.
about.costNote: Estimates, not invoices. Provider billing has rounding, promotions, free-tier credits, and the occasional model rename. Trust the provider invoice for final numbers.
about.dedupIntro: Claude Code serializes one API response as multiple JSONL lines (one per content block — text / tool-use / thinking), each carrying the same usage. We dedupe by message.id (fallback requestId) so each API call counts once. In a typical session this trims 30–50% of duplicate token counts.
about.privacyIntro: Single-user mode is fully local — no network, no telemetry. Multi-user mode sends usage counts (tokens, timestamps, cost) to the server you control. Raw conversation content is never read or transmitted.

session.breakdownDescription: Captured by the source adapter at session close.

prices.title: Price table
prices.description: Edit per-model token prices. All values are in USD per 1M tokens. Match is a case-insensitive regex against the model name.
prices.saved: Saved. Cost estimates refresh on next dashboard load.
prices.resetDone: Override removed. Falling back to bundled defaults.
prices.rulesDescription: Rules are matched in order — first match wins. Leave a row's match blank to drop it. The last (blank) row is for adding a new rule.
prices.resetDescription: Delete data/prices.json and fall back to data/prices.default.json.

tokensPage.title: API tokens
tokensPage.description: Each token authenticates one agent (e.g. one machine reporting Hermes / Codex / Claude Code usage to this server). Tokens are scoped to {user}.

tokensPage.syncSettingsDescription: How often the agent uploads on its own. The dashboard's Sync now button always responds within a couple of seconds regardless — this only controls the background heartbeat cadence.
